title: Focus on What Matters: Fisher-Guided Adaptive Multimodal Fusion for Vulnerability Detection
abstract: arXiv:2601.02438v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Software vulnerability detection can be formulated as a binary classification problem that determines whether a given code snippet contains security defects. Existing multimodal methods typically fuse Natural Code Sequence (NCS) representations extracted by pretrained models with Code Property Graph (CPG) representations extracted by graph neural networks, under the implicit assumption that introducing an additional modality necessarily yields information gain. Through empirical analysis, we demonstrate the limitations of this assumption: pretrained models already encode substantial structural information implicitly, leading to strong overlap between the two modalities; moreover, graph encoders are generally less effective than pretrained language models in feature extraction. As a result, naive fusion not only struggles to obtain complementary signals but can also dilute effective discriminative cues due to noise propagation.

translated_title: 聚焦关键信息：基于Fisher引导的自适应多模态融合漏洞检测方法
translated_abstract: 软件漏洞检测可以被形式化为一个二元分类问题，即判断给定的代码片段是否包含安全缺陷。现有的多模态方法通常将预训练模型提取的自然代码序列（NCS）表示与图神经网络提取的代码属性图（CPG）表示进行融合，其隐含假设是引入额外的模态必然会带来信息增益。通过实证分析，我们证明了这一假设的局限性：预训练模型已经隐式编码了大量结构信息，导致两种模态之间存在强烈的重叠；此外，图编码器在特征提取方面通常不如预训练语言模型有效。因此，朴素的融合方式不仅难以获得互补信号，还可能由于噪声传播而稀释有效的判别线索。
tldr: 揭示了现有多模态漏洞检测方法中预训练模型与图编码器表示高度重叠、图编码器特征提取能力不足的问题，并提出基于Fisher信息的自适应多模态融合方法，聚焦真正有效的判别特征以提升漏洞检测性能。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that existing multimodal vulnerability detection methods suffer from strong representational overlap between pretrained models and graph encoders, and proposes a Fisher-guided adaptive fusion approach that focuses on truly discriminative cues to improve detection performance.
